description: The Antlia pairs a clean white photo frame with a round clock set into the lower-right corner. Its broad, simple face keeps the photograph central, while a discreet logo sits along the bottom edge.
The Auriga brings a white horizontal photo frame and round clock into one balanced form. A small logo panel beneath the clock completes the uncluttered face.
This custom-made square frame has a bold black profile that gives the display a clear, composed edge. Inside, deep navy, red corner panels and fine gold lines bring definition to the framed piece.

This custom-made square frame pairs a substantial black profile with an ivory display and fine gold edging. Ornamental flourishes add detail, while the clean outer line keeps the presentation composed.
This compact square frame gives a pale display a neat, defined edge. An intricate green-and-gold border adds a measured touch of ornament within the dark frame.
This custom-made A3 frame presents a tall, portrait-format display within a dark, substantial border. Fine gold ornament traces the inner edges and gives the framed piece a formal finish.
This custom-made A3 frame gives its portrait-format display a strong dark outline. A precise grey border and red ribbon detail bring contrast within the frame.
This custom-made A4 frame has a clean horizontal profile that draws the eye across the display. Magenta side panels and fine gold edging create a vivid, carefully defined inner border.
This custom-made A4 frame pairs a broad dark outline with a warm ivory display. Its red-and-gold ornamental border adds richness while keeping the horizontal composition crisp.
This custom-made A5 frame gives a portrait-format display a refined dark edge. Black and gold detailing within the frame adds depth, with a crest above and fine signature line below.
This custom-made A6 frame presents a portrait-format display in a defined dark border. A black-and-gold medallion and restrained matching details lend the frame a composed finish.

The custom-printed A4 certificate is presented in a clean portrait layout, with a fine gold border, centred heading and a small gold seal near the lower edge. Its laminated finish gives the printed piece a smooth, finished surface.
The custom-printed A5 certificate uses a horizontal layout with a crisp red border and a checkered flag motif beneath the heading. Lamination gives the printed surface a neat, finished look.

The Employee Recognition Miniature is presented in a deep black frame around a warm, dimensional scene. A standing figure, vertical light details and green plants give the framed composition depth and presence.

The Forever Forest Border Frame pairs a natural brown MDF frame with a vivid border of preserved moss. Its square silhouette and richly textured green edge bring the frame itself into focus, around a small central display.

The Forever Forest Nature’s Stage is a square magnetic frame with a natural brown finish and a softly illustrated landscape. A small glass-covered botanical detail sits at the centre, giving the frame a distinct layered look.
The Logo Branded Miniature uses a black shadow-box frame to create depth around a vivid bamboo scene. A colourful linked logo sits prominently at the centre, with clean white lettering beneath.
The Mensa Photo Frame has a broad white horizontal profile with a warm, wood-look inner border. The layered frame draws a clean outline around the photograph, with a small brand mark centred below.
The Phoenix Photo Frame pairs a crisp white inner surround with a deep blue outer border. The two-tone frame gives the landscape image a clear, layered profile, finished with a matching logo below.
The Pyxis Photo Frame has a clean white horizontal profile that keeps the photograph and branding in one composed layout. A colourful city emblem and name sit neatly beneath the image.

The CEO Work Desk Miniature is set inside a white shadow-box frame, giving its detailed office scene depth. A teal backdrop, framed diagrams, tiny shelves and desk pieces sit alongside a burgundy examination table.

The Tucana Photo Frame combines a softly rounded white outer profile with a warm, wood-look inner border. The layered frame gives the photograph a gentle contrast, with a small dark logo centred below.
